name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates and admission model are not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated department policy; earlier submission by 17 December encouraged.

english.note: Department higher TOEFL threshold applies to international applicants without a degree from an English-based institution. Central policy's qualifying exemption documentation still applies; obtain confirmation of department acceptance. Central IELTS6.5, DET110 and other alternatives are university minima; confirm equivalence to department's higher TOEFL.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic fee $50. Central waivers exclude international applicants. Some departments offer selective discount codes; availability here is not confirmed.

requirements.note: GPA minimum3.0. Relevant biology, genetics, biochemistry, chemistry, calculus and physics preparation expected; one or two deficiencies may be remedied after admission. Statement should explain research fit and list chosen section and 1–4 faculty; contact encouraged. No writing sample used.

funding.note: All accepted students can receive departmental teaching-assistant support up to five years with continuing progress. Awards competitive; page currently quotes $23,000 over nine months without an award year, with possible advisor summer support. Confirm individual offer.
